parsed.internal_thinking: Alice has {Wh:2, S:2, O:1} after rolling an 8. She cannot build a settlement (needs Brick/Wood), a road (needs Brick/Wood), or a city (needs more Ore/Wheat). She has 1 Ore, 2 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. Buying a development card costs 1 Ore, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. Alice has these resources. Given Bob's dominance in Wheat and his likely pursuit of Dev cards/Cities, Alice should buy a Dev card now to keep up and potentially gain a Knight (to move the robber off her 10-adjacent tiles if it moves there) or a beneficial progress card. Node 9 is a valid future settlement spot (3:1 port), but she lacks the resources to build toward it this turn. Buying a Dev card is the most productive use of her current hand.
